read: 2026-10-11, by eye from the cached layout image
comment: Small 13x9 LFO daughterboard for the 1776 Multiplex delay; bare cuts-and-jumpers board on top (not counted), populated board below. R7 is printed as a designator with its value (330k, 180k in original) in the legend; D2 on the board and the off-board Speed LED are both 5mm diffused yellow. Power filtering and polarity protection come from the main board.
rows: any dual op amp should do
